record.bible_text: And the LORD<WH03068> spake<WH01696><WTH8762> unto Moses<WH04872> after<WH0310> the death<WH04194> of the two<WH08147> sons<WH01121> of Aaron<WH0175>, when they offered<WH07126><WTH8800> before<WH06440> the LORD<WH03068>, and died<WH04191><WTH8799>;
